properties.description: The increment in which the design started answering two questions about ITSELF that a user asks in their own words — what still rests on a patch, and what fraction of any declared kind carries a given relation — plus the field-feedback work that preceded them: a startup refusal no peer can resolve stops the wait instead of reaching the client as CONNECT_TIMEOUT, and a registered report that produced no finding is reported. Both new reports were built so that an EMPTY answer says which empty it is: 248 of 248 repairs unstated, and an undeclared node type refused rather than counted as zero.
